name: Panel Opening
description: Defines Opening features (windows or doors) for a panel component's 'features' input. By default an opening is built by the populator's FramedOpeningDetailSet: framed in the core and cut through every layer; give it its own detail set via 'detail_set'.

inputParameters.name: outlines
inputParameters.description: Closed opening outlines, drawn on or parallel to the panel they belong to. They are projected through the panel thickness.

inputParameters.name: project_horizontal
inputParameters.description: If True, sloped openings are extruded horizontally through the panel instead of along its normal.

inputParameters.name: detail_set
inputParameters.description: (Optional) A detail set (CT: Detail Agent Set) that builds these features, in place of the populator's default for this feature type.

outputParameters.name: features
outputParameters.description: Panel feature definitions. Connect to a panel component's 'features' input; each panel adds the ones that lie on it.
